items.title: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
items.summary: Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster says an OpenAI researcher pressured him after information about his AI-assisted progress on the Navier-Stokes equations allegedly reached the company. The researcher tried to remove his co-author because he works at Anthropic and threatened Buckmaster when he refused, according to Buckmaster's account. OpenAI then claimed its own breakthrough using the same unusual solution path. Buckmaster had uploaded all his drafts to Codex. OpenAI told him the model didn't look up user data, but when he asked about training, he says he got no answer. OpenAI denies the allegations. The article OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 數學家崔斯坦・巴克馬斯特（Tristan Buckmaster）表示，在據稱有關他利用 AI 協助納維-斯托克斯方程式（Navier-Stokes equations）進展的資訊傳到該公司後，一名 OpenAI 研究人員向他施壓。根據巴克馬斯特的說法，該研究人員試圖剔除他的共同作者，因為對方在 Anthropic 工作，並在巴克馬斯特拒絕時威脅了他。隨後，OpenAI 宣稱使用相同的非尋常解法取得了突破。巴克馬斯特將他所有的草稿都上傳到了 Codex。OpenAI 告訴他，該模型不會查詢使用者資料，但當他詢問關於訓練的問題時，他表示沒有得到任何答案。OpenAI 否認了這些指控。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章「研究人員據稱施壓數學家，要求其在重大數學突破論文中剔除 Anthropic 共同作者」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia
items.summary: Coca-Cola is using AI to recommend which products Malaysian retailers should order and in what quantities through its Coke Buddy platform. The Perfect Basket feature uses Coca-Cola’s Central Recommendation Engine to analyse previous orders, ordering frequency, seasonality, weather, and purchasing patterns among similar businesses. Coca-Cola said Coke Buddy currently supports about 39,000 retail outlets across […] The post Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: 可口可樂（Coca-Cola）正在透過其 Coke Buddy 平臺利用人工智慧，向馬來西亞零售商推薦應訂購哪些產品以及具體數量。「完美購物籃」（Perfect Basket）功能採用可口可樂的中央推薦引擎，來分析類似商家先前的訂單、訂購頻率、季節性、天氣和購買模式。可口可樂表示，Coke Buddy 目前支援全馬約 39,000 個零售據點 […] 這篇文章 Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia 最早出現於 AI News。

It also forecasts cloud cover and how much sunlight reaches the surface, and it updates every hour. Energy traders, grid operators and wind and solar developers already pay other companies for that […] The post AI weather forecasting enters the energy market as Google targets grid operators with WeatherNext 3 appeared first on AI News .

items.title: YouTube Appears in 53% of Google AI Overviews for Vitamin and Supplement Searches
items.summary: YouTube was the most frequently cited website in Google AI Overviews across a panel of vitamin and supplement searches, according to new research. The video platform appeared in 186 of 350 AI-generated answers, or 53.1%, making it the only website cited in more than half of the answers collected. Searcherries followed 50 searches daily from […] The post YouTube Appears in 53% of Google AI Overviews for Vitamin and Supplement Searches appeared first on AI News .

items.title: DeepSeek招募150名資深工程師 重點加碼Agent工程化與DSec基建
items.summary: 9月8日，DeepSeek啓動約150人工程師招聘，聚焦服務端開發與Agent彈性計算研發，重點招2至10年資深後端工程師，未設AI研究崗。這是繼6月全部門擴招後又一動作，顯示戰略重心從純模型研究轉向Agent工程化與基礎設施建設，涉及大模型研究平臺、Agent框架組件及DeepSeek API。

items.title: 臺灣大哥大發表MyAgent平臺，加速從AI助理走向數位員工
items.summary: 生成式 AI 技術熱炒了兩年，市場正從「問答聊天」迅速轉向能代勞實際工作流程的 AI Agent。臺灣大哥大今天（9/8）舉辦「D.E.E.P. Tech Day 2026」硬科技日，發表其自研的企業級AI Agent平臺MyAgent，並和精誠資訊聯手，試圖解決企業匯入AI時面臨的算力成本、模型選擇、資料安全與系統整合等問題。

items.title: Palo Alto Networks揭露攻擊者利用AI代理在10小時內攻破企業網路，竊取root憑證
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks研究人員於9月2日揭露一起企業網路入侵事件，發現攻擊者利用頂尖AI模型及專用AI代理框架，在不到10小時內，完成原本以人力需要花費大約兩週時間的入侵流程。研究人員發現，攻擊者並未利用全新零時差漏洞或特殊攻擊技術，而是藉由AI代理大幅提高攻擊鏈的速度。

items.title: AI重建16.6萬神經元果蠅中樞神經圖，可追蹤感官與動作路徑
items.summary: 美國霍華休斯醫學研究所（HHMI）旗下Janelia Research Campus與Google Research等團隊，利用AI重建神經元3D結構，完成雄性黑腹果蠅完整中樞神經系統連線圖，相關論文刊登於《Cell》。研究資料涵蓋超過16.6萬個神經元與1.25億個突觸連接，範圍從腦部延伸到控制身體動作的腹神經索，可追蹤視覺、聽覺與嗅覺等感官訊號到動作輸出。

items.title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
items.summary: We look at r-1, the document parsing model Reducto released on September 1, 2026. We walk through how it folds OCR, layout detection, tables, formatting and grounding into one full page pass, replacing the multi stage agentic pipeline it ships alongside. We break down the two numbers that matter for a migration decision: a reported 20% error reduction and a flat 1 cent per page rate against the legacy 3 to 6 cents. The post Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 我們來看看 Reducto 於 2026 年 9 月 1 日發布的文件解析模型 r-1。我們將介紹它如何將 OCR、版面偵測、表格、格式化和定位（grounding）整合到單一的整頁處理流程中，以取代其隨附的多階段代理式（agentic）管線。我們詳細分析了做出遷移決策時最重要的兩個數字：據報導錯誤率降低了 20%，以及每頁固定 1 美分的費率（相較於舊版的每頁 3 到 6 美分）。這篇文章 Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Anthropic 放棄收購 AI 初創公司 Decart，這樁 60 億美元交易最終告吹
items.summary: 據報，Anthropic已決定放棄收購AI初創公司Decart。雙方曾就約60億美元交易洽談，Anthropic完成盡職調查後退出，未來或尋求其他合作。Anthropic正加大算力投入開發新品，而Decart的軟件可提升芯片利用效率、降低AI訓練運行成本，這或是收購動因，但交易最終未成。

items.summary: 小鵬機器人生產線今日正式啓用，全球首條高階人形機器人自動化產線完成總裝，機器人自主走下產線亮相，標誌其從研發試製跨越到產線製造。該產線針對行業小批量、半手工裝配及規模化製造難題，借鑑汽車工業成熟質量體系，推動人形機器人向規模量產邁進。

items.title: 宇樹科技實現全球首次世界模型實時驅動人形機器人自主格鬥
items.summary: 9月7日，宇樹科技宣佈實現全球首次由世界模型實時驅動的全自主人形機器人格鬥。其基於UnifoLM-X2-1.0，突破世界—動作大模型在瞬時規劃、決策與動態交互執行上的技術瓶頸，使機器人在高動態、強交互場景下實時預測規劃並自主執行搏擊動作，驗證了世界模型驅動機器人的可行性與應用潛力。

items.title: AI技能已成為進入瑞銀的必要條件
items.summary: 英國金融時報（Financial Times，FT）本週引述訊息來源報導，瑞銀集團（UBS Group AG，UBS）已全面要求新進人員必須具備AI使用能力，不管是實習生還是畢業生，成為首批明確要求初級銀行員必須具備AI素養的大型金融機構之一。 根據報導，瑞銀將要求2027年加入其全球銀行與市場部門的應屆畢業生與實習生，得證明自己可用AI來提高業績與效率，也包括會在面試中加入AI熟練度的問題，以測試應徵者如何使用AI。

items.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
items.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
items.summary: Anthropic signed compute contracts worth up to $517 billion in eleven months but still trails OpenAI's $750 billion plan through 2030. In early 2026, CEO Dario Amodei warned against investing too fast. Now Anthropic is racing to catch up, while Sam Altman warns about "unsustainable silliness" in the compute buildout, especially from neo-cloud providers. The article Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 11 個月內簽署了高達 5,170 億美元的運算合約，但其 2030 年前的規模仍落後於 OpenAI's 的 7,500 億美元計畫。2026 年初，執行長 Dario Amodei 曾警告不要投資過快。現在 Anthropic 正急起直追，而 Sam Altman 則警告運算基礎設施建設中存在「不可持續的荒謬現象」，特別是來自新雲端服務供應商的建設。這篇題為〈Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
items_ai.summary: Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster says an OpenAI researcher pressured him after information about his AI-assisted progress on the Navier-Stokes equations allegedly reached the company. The researcher tried to remove his co-author because he works at Anthropic and threatened Buckmaster when he refused, according to Buckmaster's account. OpenAI then claimed its own breakthrough using the same unusual solution path. Buckmaster had uploaded all his drafts to Codex. OpenAI told him the model didn't look up user data, but when he asked about training, he says he got no answer. OpenAI denies the allegations. The article OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 數學家崔斯坦・巴克馬斯特（Tristan Buckmaster）表示，在據稱有關他利用 AI 協助納維-斯托克斯方程式（Navier-Stokes equations）進展的資訊傳到該公司後，一名 OpenAI 研究人員向他施壓。根據巴克馬斯特的說法，該研究人員試圖剔除他的共同作者，因為對方在 Anthropic 工作，並在巴克馬斯特拒絕時威脅了他。隨後，OpenAI 宣稱使用相同的非尋常解法取得了突破。巴克馬斯特將他所有的草稿都上傳到了 Codex。OpenAI 告訴他，該模型不會查詢使用者資料，但當他詢問關於訓練的問題時，他表示沒有得到任何答案。OpenAI 否認了這些指控。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章「研究人員據稱施壓數學家，要求其在重大數學突破論文中剔除 Anthropic 共同作者」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: Palo Alto Networks揭露攻擊者利用AI代理在10小時內攻破企業網路，竊取root憑證
items_ai.summary: Palo Alto Networks研究人員於9月2日揭露一起企業網路入侵事件，發現攻擊者利用頂尖AI模型及專用AI代理框架，在不到10小時內，完成原本以人力需要花費大約兩週時間的入侵流程。研究人員發現，攻擊者並未利用全新零時差漏洞或特殊攻擊技術，而是藉由AI代理大幅提高攻擊鏈的速度。

items_ai.title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
items_ai.summary: We look at r-1, the document parsing model Reducto released on September 1, 2026. We walk through how it folds OCR, layout detection, tables, formatting and grounding into one full page pass, replacing the multi stage agentic pipeline it ships alongside. We break down the two numbers that matter for a migration decision: a reported 20% error reduction and a flat 1 cent per page rate against the legacy 3 to 6 cents. The post Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 我們來看看 Reducto 於 2026 年 9 月 1 日發布的文件解析模型 r-1。我們將介紹它如何將 OCR、版面偵測、表格、格式化和定位（grounding）整合到單一的整頁處理流程中，以取代其隨附的多階段代理式（agentic）管線。我們詳細分析了做出遷移決策時最重要的兩個數字：據報導錯誤率降低了 20%，以及每頁固定 1 美分的費率（相較於舊版的每頁 3 到 6 美分）。這篇文章 Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
items_ai.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
items_ai.summary: Anthropic signed compute contracts worth up to $517 billion in eleven months but still trails OpenAI's $750 billion plan through 2030. In early 2026, CEO Dario Amodei warned against investing too fast. Now Anthropic is racing to catch up, while Sam Altman warns about "unsustainable silliness" in the compute buildout, especially from neo-cloud providers. The article Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 11 個月內簽署了高達 5,170 億美元的運算合約，但其 2030 年前的規模仍落後於 OpenAI's 的 7,500 億美元計畫。2026 年初，執行長 Dario Amodei 曾警告不要投資過快。現在 Anthropic 正急起直追，而 Sam Altman 則警告運算基礎設施建設中存在「不可持續的荒謬現象」，特別是來自新雲端服務供應商的建設。這篇題為〈Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。
